findings.userImpact: A different APK could be presented as the installed and Pixel-verified artifact.
findings.rootCause: Prior evidence was regenerated independently without an immutable source/bundle/APK/certificate/install binding.
findings.recommendedFix: Generate final provenance after the APK build and bind installed and Pixel evidence hashes in the Release 4C manifest.
findings.regressionTest: scripts/generate-release4-provenance.ts rejects a missing embedded bundle and records the exact current APK, source-tree and certificate hashes; Android Pixel sentinel validation rejects invalid renders.
findings.closure: Standalone APK SHA-256 08420343A9251E9667B72880560F57F29BAA944A54D4860BE14CA43F20AA3053 is different from the supplied baseline, contains embedded Hermes C39A72869219B5449B72D0370EB6D031FEDDFD278BA63A41C1165680E2BCEF41, was fresh-installed, and is explicitly classified internal-only. Pixel APK SHA and 9 valid adb captures are separately bound.

findings.userImpact: Self-approved or stale high-risk content could cross the public publish boundary.
findings.rootCause: The former four-state model lacked immutable revisions, content hashes, role-separated approvals and transition CAS.
findings.recommendedFix: Use revision-bound approvals, server transition allowlists, active reviewer roles, role separation and CAS publish.
findings.regressionTest: catalog-v2-admin E2E covers author/reviewer/publisher separation, inactive reviewer 403, stale revision/hash 409 and one-winner concurrent publish.
findings.closure: Additive workflow revisions, approvals, reviewer credentials and events enforce author != reviewer/publisher and high-risk safety reviewer != publisher; payload hash changes invalidate approvals.

findings.userImpact: Viewer or gift participants could mutate plans or link cross-household members and expenses.
findings.rootCause: Mutation and foreign-key checks validated existence but not role and household scope.
findings.recommendedFix: Restrict mutations to owner/co_parent and validate assignee and expense scope.
findings.regressionTest: Catalog E2E role matrix denies viewer/gift mutation and cross-household assignee/expense identifiers.
findings.closure: Role-based mutation guards and same-household validation are enforced before create/update/delete.

findings.userImpact: Gift participants could read sensitive household amounts and payer details.
findings.rootCause: All active household roles received the same report projection.
findings.recommendedFix: Deny general reports to gift participants and expose only an explicit gift allowlist.
findings.regressionTest: Reports E2E allows owner/co_parent/viewer and returns 403 with no amount payload for gift_participant.
findings.closure: General Report V2/V3 endpoints fail closed for gift participants.

findings.userImpact: A gift-only list could expose inventory, memo, assignee, bundle and cost fields.
findings.rootCause: The gift projection reused the full household item-plan DTO.
findings.recommendedFix: Return a dedicated allowlisted gift_expected projection.
findings.regressionTest: Gift projection E2E asserts item name and desired quantity are present and all sensitive fields are absent.
findings.closure: Gift participants receive only explicitly shared gift_expected item name and desired quantity.

findings.userImpact: Concurrent clients could overwrite each other or surface a database error.
findings.rootCause: Expected version was checked before an unconditional update.
findings.recommendedFix: Use updateMany CAS and normalize create races.
findings.regressionTest: Parallel same-version update yields one success and one 409; parallel create never returns 500 or duplicates.

findings.userImpact: A stale active pregnancy profile could continue driving recommendations after birth/manual transition.
findings.rootCause: Child and maternal updates were not atomic and always reactivated the maternal profile.
findings.recommendedFix: Update atomically and activate only for pregnant stage.
findings.regressionTest: Pregnant-to-born/manual transition deactivates the maternal context in one transaction.

findings.userImpact: Concurrent editors could overwrite content or lose taxonomy ancestors.
findings.rootCause: Catalog edits lacked server version/hash CAS and complete ancestor derivation.
findings.recommendedFix: Persist revisions and derive the full primary taxonomy chain.
findings.regressionTest: Stale writes return 409; mapping update preserves one complete ancestor chain.

findings.userImpact: Unapproved content could leak from non-production-like deployments.
findings.rootCause: Preview was inferred from NODE_ENV rather than an explicit privileged profile.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep public endpoints published-only and isolate internal preview behind explicit config and authorization.
findings.regressionTest: All public profiles return published-only; production contamination gate fails if preview/test flags enter the bundle.

findings.userImpact: Named preparation scenarios could contain unrelated rotating items.
findings.rootCause: Bundle membership was generated from item slices rather than canonical item specifications.
findings.regressionTest: Thirty bundles have explicit members, no duplicate rows and lifecycle/context consistency.

findings.userImpact: Operators could not safely preview CSV/XLSX, bind imports to revisions or roll back edits.
findings.rootCause: The importer accepted only parsed JSON and catalog edits had no immutable history.
findings.recommendedFix: Add bounded CSV/XLSX parsing, manifest dry-run, revision/hash validation, partial reports and rollback as new revision.
findings.regressionTest: Parser security tests and Admin E2E cover formula/size/schema defenses, idempotency, stale revision and rollback-new-revision.

findings.userImpact: Coverage counts could not distinguish applicability from typed gaps.
findings.recommendedFix: Persist applicability, gap type and rationale with fail-closed review_needed.
findings.regressionTest: Coverage evidence reports 1,824 classified cells and unclassified=0.
findings.closure: 1,200 unresolved gaps remain review_needed/external-review-blocked; this is not a completeness or approval claim.

findings.userImpact: An old price could be displayed as current.
findings.rootCause: Price input did not require an observation timestamp.
findings.recommendedFix: Require observedAt, approval and freshness display.
findings.regressionTest: Price without observedAt is rejected and unapproved offers remain absent from public comparison.
findings.closure: Approved active offer count remains zero because no merchant approval data was supplied.

findings.userImpact: The required runner could not reproduce installation or release gates.
findings.rootCause: pnpm 11 required a newer Node runtime.
findings.recommendedFix: Pin a lockfile-compatible pnpm supporting Node 20.
findings.regressionTest: Node 20.20.2 with pnpm 10.28.1 completes frozen install and all eleven release gates.

findings.userImpact: A partial green subset could be mistaken for a complete release result.
findings.rootCause: The gate lacked deterministic build environment ownership and robust step diagnostics.
findings.recommendedFix: Own a non-secret HTTPS production fixture, bounded diagnostics and strict production contamination checks.
findings.regressionTest: Eleven of eleven gates pass; missing or HTTP production URLs still fail closed.

findings.userImpact: Scheduled items could remain unpublished or bypass fresh approval checks when the publisher runs.
findings.rootCause: The publisher job handled only the legacy content path.
findings.recommendedFix: Revalidate role, revision, hash and approvals at due time and use CAS publish.
findings.regressionTest: Concurrent due-publish execution produces exactly one publish event and blocks stale/invalid approvals.

findings.userImpact: Every API replica silently served fallback config instead of the database-managed version.
findings.rootCause: The service queried release3 while the migration/seed key was public_app_config.
findings.recommendedFix: Use the seeded canonical key and assert the response source.
findings.regressionTest: App-config E2E asserts X-Config-Source=database; local API ports 53100 and 53101 both return source=database/version=1.

findings.userImpact: Some width, font-scale, screen-reader and non-happy-path defects may remain outside the nine Pixel screens and smoke flow.
findings.rootCause: The route manifest classifies all states, but the available Android run covered only the core smoke path and nine Pixel routes.
findings.recommendedFix: Run all applicable route states on the 63 layout combinations and representative Android 13/14/15 devices with TalkBack.
findings.regressionTest: Every applicable route-state-layout cell carries installed evidence and no critical accessibility blocker.

findings.userImpact: The local implementation cannot establish expert content approval, real provider behavior or production recovery.
findings.rootCause: No external reviewers, merchant data, staging accounts, production signing identity or Play beta were supplied.
findings.recommendedFix: Complete external review manifests and staged operational qualification without self-approval.
findings.regressionTest: External staging, real-provider, signed AAB, restore/rollback and closed-beta evidence must bind to the final release manifest.
